result.summary: The food delivery home screen is mostly polished, but several cards and chips are clipped at the screen edges, and one restaurant listing is cut off mid-scroll.

issues.description: The last restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' row is cut off on the right, truncating the name to 'Trattoria Piccol' and hiding the rest of the card.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent horizontal padding or allow the carousel to peek the next card without clipping text; ensure names wrap or ellipsize fully within the visible card.

issues.description: The last item in the category chip row ('Healthy') is partially cut off at the right edge of the screen.
issues.suggestion: Give the chip scroller enough end padding so the last chip is fully visible, or show a clearer peek of the next chip.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' restaurant card is cropped at the bottom of the viewport, so only the image is visible and the restaurant name/details are missing.
issues.suggestion: This may be expected mid-scroll, but consider ensuring cards snap so titles remain visible or add a bit more bottom padding above the tab bar.
